desc: Implement sliding-median window cost: two heaps with lazy deletion and running sums; cost = median*len(low) − sum(low) + sum(high) − median*len(high).
Implement main DP: dp[i][j] = min(skip, take) with take jumping x ahead; ring buffer for O(x·k) space.
Verify provided examples (8 and 3) — worker claims match.
Stress-test full solution vs brute force (naive per-window median + exhaustive/naive DP) on small random arrays including negatives, duplicates, x = n, k·x = n, zero-cost windows.

Audit ring-buffer DP indexing carefully (ring size x+1, base rows for indices ≥ m, retrieval of dp[i+1] and dp[i+x]) for off-by-one or aliasing bugs (e.g., ring[idx] all pointing to same base row object is fine only if never mutated).
Finalize code in starter class with imports; confirm complexity O(n log x + n·k).
